in_greek.name: Mel
in_greek.long_meaning: Mel είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Originally derived from the Greek name 'Melanios', meaning 'black'. In the Bible, Melchizedek is a king of Salem and a priest, who offers a sacrifice to God. Melanion is a character in Greek mythology, a shepherd who was transformed into a stag and hunted by his own hounds.

Melanion is a character in Greek mythology, a shepherd who was transformed into a stag and hunted by his own hounds.
